# dsh-vidi
English | 中文
A video tool for DeepSeek Harness: watch live streams, videos and podcasts with subtitles in any lan
guage, and let DeepSeek take frames, cut clips, download and summarise for you.
## What it does
- **Opens anything**: YouTube, Bilibili and other sites yt-dlp supports, Xiaoyuzhou podcast episodes

, m3u8 / rtmp / srt streams, local files (drop them in), or a stream pushed from OBS.
- **Subtitles
start by themselves** when a video opens; pause and resume any time. One or two languages (a main li

ne and a second line); the site's own subtitles can be shown too, or used as a reference.
- **Two pa
ces**: real-time shows lines as they are heard; polished arrives a little later with misheard words
fixed from context. In the subtitle list, polished lines carry a small tick; lines not polished yet

are lighter.
- **The subtitle model looks at the video**: polishing uses the page's title, descripti
on and comments, and — when the chosen model reads images — a frame of that stretch. It also keeps a

glossary of names and terms for the video.
- **Chat with DeepSeek beside the video**: grab this mom
ent, cut this part, summarise, download the original — all in one conversation, with files saved in

the video's folder.
- **Restream**: push the video with its subtitles drawn into the picture to Bili
bili, Douyin, Kuaishou, WeChat Channels, Douyu, Huya, YouTube, Twitch or any RTMP/SRT address — seve

ral at once; each platform connects and reconnects on its own.
- **Voiceover**: the subtitles spoken
over the picture in another language — English in, Chinese out, or the other way round — with a voi
ce from OpenAI, SiliconFlow, Gemini or ElevenLabs, or one made from a recording (your own voice read
into the microphone, an audio file, or someone talking in the video). The original sound is lowered

under it or turned off; restreams and clips carry it too.
- **Download and export**: the original o
r a video with subtitle tracks, just the sound (M4A), SRT / VTT subtitles, transcripts by line or pa

ragraph.
- English and Chinese interface; works on phones.
## Install
In DSH, open **Plugins → Install third-party plugin** and enter `dsh-vidi`. A **Vidi video** button
appears in the sidebar (the video page takes the main area like a chat, and the sidebar opens and cl
oses as usual); pasting a video link in a chat also offers to open it.
Needs DSH 0.2.2 or later.
### Dependencies
| Tool | For | Install (macOS) |

| ffmpeg | playing, recording, frames, clips | `brew install ffmpeg` |
| yt-dlp | site videos | `bre

w install yt-dlp` |
| whisper.cpp (optional) | transcription on this computer | `brew install whispe
r-cpp`, then put `ggml-large-v3-turbo-q5_0.bin` in `~/.dsh/live/models/` |
Without whisper.cpp, pick an online service as the transcription model in settings.
## Two models
Set separately under the gear:
- **Transcription**: speech to text. Whisper on this computer by default; or OpenAI, Google Gemini,

Groq, SiliconFlow, Zhipu GLM.
- **Subtitle model**: polishing, translation, glossary. DeepSeek by de
fault; the list shows every model configured in DSH and marks the ones that read images.
Online transcription uses the model providers you have set up in DSH (Models page) — OpenAI, Google,
Groq, SiliconFlow, Zhipu GLM: their key and address work as they are, whatever the key is called. A
service DSH doesn't have yet can get a key right on the video page; it is checked, then saved in DS
ervice DSH doesn't have yet can get a key right on the video page; it is checked, then saved in DSH.
## Restreaming
In the player, open **Restream**, add a platform (paste the server address and stream key from the p
latform's own streaming tool — e.g. Bilibili 直播姬, Douyin 直播伴侣, WeChat Channels Assistant), tick the
ones to use and start. It starts from where you are watching, with the subtitles you see; for a live
stream that is a few seconds behind live, so the lines are ready. Stream keys stay on this computer
stream that is a few seconds behind live, so the lines are ready. Stream keys stay on this computer.
## Streaming from OBS
Open the video page: the empty page shows the server address and stream key. In OBS choose the "Cust
om" service and paste them. Default ports: RTMP 1935, SRT 9000 (changeable in the plugin settings).
## Where things are saved
Recordings, subtitles, frames and clips live in `~/.dsh/live/jobs/<id>/` (changeable in the plugin s
s, subtitles, frames and clips live in `~/.dsh/live/jobs/<id>/` (changeable in the plugin settings).
## Known limits
- Xiaoyuzhou video episodes only offer a one-minute preview on the web (the full video needs the app

and a login), so they play as the full audio with the cover.
- Site videos that need a login use a
browser's saved login (Settings → Site login).
